retained_primary_inputs.title: Gareth A. Jones, Primitive permutation groups containing a cycle
retained_primary_inputs.locator: Corollary1.3, page2: a primitive group containing a cycle with at least3 fixed points contains A_n, without prime-length hypothesis. Theorem1.2 depends on the classification of finite simple groups.

scope: The previous rank4 use needed prime-cycle Theorem1.1; the all-rank result needs the stronger composite-cycle Corollary1.3. Remaining identities are proved in the canonical note.
